construction: 93 parts in 15 steps. Steps 1–10: a stack of 8×8, 1×12 and other plates. Step 7: ten 2×6 dark-red tiles form the outer skin. Step 11: seven 2×4×1⅓ curved-top bricks along one edge make the rounded bilge. Step 13: black 33° slopes and two 10×3 double-rounded wedges along the other edge. Step 14: three 4×6 trap-door plates with bars.
interfaces: All 93 parts point up in the section's own frame. The parent matrix `0 −0.986 0.164 / 1 0 0 / 0 0.164 0.986` turns the studs to +X and angles the wall 9.4° in plan to follow the hull's taper. The mirror section `2.11.2` is placed studs −X on the other side.
lesson: A ship's hull side is built as a flat plate-and-tile panel, then stood on its side. The panel's top becomes the hull's outside.
parent_context: The red lower hull wall of the bow box (`10294 - Titanic - Box 1.ldr`).
reuse_notes: Build each hull side flat, then stand it; build the mirror side as its own section.
